text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple developed paragraphs on different future goals","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures how fully an essay expands and supports its main points rather than just stating them."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like \"First thing,\" \"Fact checkers say,\" \"Last thing\"","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how clearly the writing is structured and how smoothly it moves from one point to the next."},{"evidence":"\"I will try to take more years of school\"; \"Now I take lessons for it\"; \"I have stared to play basketball more\"","quality":"verb control","description":"This captures more consistent handling of verb tense and verb forms across the essay."},{"evidence":"\"learning about the future is something I would have never thought I would do\"; \"The limits of your language are the limits of the world\"","quality":"sentence variety","description":"This captures use of more varied sentence patterns, including more complex constructions."},{"evidence":"\"Witgettein\"; \"corona virus\"; \"accomplish always having fun\"","quality":"vocabulary range","description":"This captures a wider and more flexible choice of words and expressions for different ideas."},{"evidence":"maintains several connected paragraphs without a closing repetition","quality":"task elaboration","description":"This captures a stronger ability to sustain and extend responses with multiple supporting details."}]}
